meta.name: auth-implementation-patterns
meta.description: Master authentication and authorization patterns including JWT, OAuth2, session management, and RBAC to build secure, scalable access control systems. Use when implementing auth systems, securing APIs, or debugging security issues.

copy.tagline: 为应用加上登录认证和权限校验,防止未授权访问
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发应用并需要实现用户登录和权限管理
copy.tagline_en: Add login and permission checks to your app to block unauthorized access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building an app and need to add user login and permission management

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会围绕认证与授权给出实现模式，覆盖 JWT、OAuth2、会话管理和 RBAC 等，并提示安全最佳实践与常见陷阱。
howto.when: 触发时机：当你提出实现认证系统、保护 API 或调试安全问题时，该技能会被触发并给出指导。

say.text: 帮我写一个基于 JWT 的用户登录认证实现
say.note: Claude 会给出 JWT 实现模式和最佳实践。

say.text: 我的 API 没有限流，怎么防止暴力破解？
say.note: Claude 会给出限流和防爆破的配置建议。

say.text: 请帮我设计基于角色的权限控制系统（RBAC）
say.note: Claude 会给出 RBAC 的模式和示例。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude provides implementation patterns for authentication and authorization, covering JWT, OAuth2, session management, RBAC, etc., along with security best practices and common pitfalls.
howto.when_en: When you ask to implement an auth system, secure an API, or debug security issues, the skill is triggered to provide guidance.

say_en.text: Help me write a JWT-based user login authentication.
say_en.note: Claude provides JWT implementation patterns and best practices.

say_en.text: My API has no rate limiting. How do I prevent brute force?
say_en.note: Claude suggests rate limiting and brute-force protection.

say_en.text: Please help me design a role-based access control (RBAC) system.
say_en.note: Claude provides RBAC patterns and examples.
